the_instrument.name: SCORE-9 FRESH HELD-OUT CONFIRMATION (F31c)

the_set.construction: 12 FRESH failure scenarios (rotary dryer, cooling tower, plant-air compressor, aeration basin, steam boiler, cooling-water pump, baghouse, chiller, overland conveyor, distillation column, wind-turbine gearbox, cold store) x 2 draws; the F31a item schema (intervention-proposal, the standard existing-instrumentation constraint shape, user_variables empty, no draft embedded)
the_set.disjointness: checked by scripts/r123_build_fresh_set.py at build time: zero domain nouns shared with the F30/F31a families, zero burned problem-id collisions (the manifest committed in key.json)
the_set.no_tuning_guarantee: NO defect ground truth is authored or seeded for the fresh set — the amendment-1 detectors (the committed logic, imported byte-identical from scripts/r121_successor_score.py) are the ONLY defect definition, exactly as in the F31b scoring; the scenario bytes freeze at this commit and never change after the first run byte (Art. 4)

the_arms.bare_only: agnes-3.0-flash, ONE call per item: the r118 AUTHORING_DIRECTIVE bytes + the problem JSON + the question (the F31a bare arm shape, imported from scripts/r118_authoring_run.py); raw completion committed verbatim; NO binds, NO repair, NO reviewer
the_arms.successor: the SAME bare authoring call (one fresh call per item; the bare and successor arms share the item's single authoring draw, byte-identical, like the F31b construction), then (1) the bind CHECK layer over the authored bill (the stripped machine's own deterministic scans, imported from scripts/r121_successor_run.py — zero LLM), (2) the findings SURFACED verbatim to a BARE REVIEWER: ONE agnes-3.0-flash call per item, the r121 FIX_DIRECTIVE bytes (the F30 working-reviewer shape, imported, NOT improved — the dir-3 residual-class lever is a separate instrument and must not confound this confirmation); the reviewer's output is the DELIVERED bill

the_instrument.n_calls_budget: 24 authoring + 24 reviewer = 48 calls worst case on the direct transport with the 2-key rotation; byte-skip resume per item per arm (one call per item per leg, ever — Art. 29(c)); typed TYPED_FAIL + 120 s backoff on transport storms; if the quota probe fails at start, the claim stays OPEN typed INFRA_QUOTA_WALL and the run defers

scoring.delivered_defect_rate_PRIMARY: per arm, the fraction of the 24 DELIVERED bills carrying >= 1 defect class under the AMENDMENT-1 DETECTORS (the machine's own bind scans over (prob, delivered_bill); UNSTATED-only formatting demands excluded; DETECTOR_ERROR fail-closed)
scoring.paired_bootstrap: per-item defect indicator, bare_only minus successor, percentile bootstrap 10k, seed 123 (pre-registered here, fresh for the fresh set)
scoring.damage_gate: among items whose bare bill was CLEAN, the fraction where the successor's DELIVERED bill carries a class the bare bill lacked — must be <= 0.25
scoring.score9_acceptance_gates: the score-9 axis (as enacted by the auditor, R122) is ACCEPTED ON THE FRESH SET iff successor rate <= 0.25 AND the paired CI excludes 0 below bare (lower bound > 0) AND damage <= 0.25; else TYPED_NEGATIVE with the per-class table + the damage rows (the axis question returns to the auditor)

the_instrument.leakage_controls: the sealed key never enters any prompt; the reviewer sees the problem + the bill + the findings ONLY; the detectors are the committed amendment-1 logic; zero judge calls; the set's key.json is never read by the runner or the scorer

ordering_guarantee: this prereg + the frozen set + the claim register in ONE push BEFORE any run byte (no authoring or reviewer call has started; the quota probe is the first transport contact and it precedes only after this push)
invalidates: NOTHING (the F31b positive stands as measured on the seeded battery; this is its held-out confirmation). No new guards, no new claim kinds (dir 8); the runner/scorer import the committed instrument bytes, never re-declare them
